Prosimians / New World monkeys / Old World monkeys (block header)

E: brain weight in grams, mean of female and male adults
Jerison's number of "extra" neurons Nc = [E^(2/3) - (0.03 P^(2/3))^(2/3)] x 8 x 10^7, RECOMPUTED here from P and E using the formula printed in the Methods; the Appendix does not print Nc
Note: derived by this repo, not a printed value; validated against Table I/II correlations (see README); paper expresses Nc as Nc/10^7 in Fig. 1

Definition: Hofman's extra cortical surface Se = 0.065 P^(2/3) {[E/(0.015 P^0.732)] - 1}, recomputed
